email.subject: Following up on your interview
email.body:
Hi,

Thank you for interviewing for the Frontend Developer role at Glasshouse Labs last week, and for the effort you put into the technical session.

After a lot of discussion, we've decided to proceed with another candidate whose experience is closer to what the team needs right now. This was a difficult decision, and we enjoyed getting to know you.

If you'd like feedback on your interviews, just reply and I'll set up a short call.

All the best,
Megan Shaw
Recruiter
